about: P4a integration (plan 7 #299): the TNC 640 cycle manual resets cycle 10 with a rotation angle of 0 and cycle 8 by defining it again without an axis (NO ENT, an empty 8.1). IROT is an increment of the angle: one of 0 changes nothing. Cycle 10 and cycle 8 each have a group of their own, so the reset of one leaves the other frame open.

states.about: The move after the reset is in the program's own frame.
IROT+0 adds nothing: the rotation stays.
8.1 names the mirrored axes, which carry no value.
The reset of the rotation leaves the mirror.
The empty 8.1 (NO ENT) ends the mirror.
